findings_samples.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings_samples.recommendation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload' to all HTTPS responses.

findings_samples.title: Missing Clickjacking Defense (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
findings_samples.recommendation: Add 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN' or 'frame-ancestors 'self'' to prevent unauthorized framing.

findings_samples.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings_samples.recommendation: Set 'Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin' to protect internal analytics and sensitive query tokens.

findings_samples.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
findings_samples.recommendation: Declare 'Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()' to restrict unnecessary hardware access.

findings_samples.title: X-Powered-By Header Discloses Technology Stack
findings_samples.recommendation: Remove X-Powered-By header via server configuration or application middleware.

findings_samples.title: Passive Mixed Content Detected (Insecure Images / Media)
findings_samples.recommendation: Update media URLs to https:// or use protocol-relative or site-root paths.
